title: Evidence bundles and briefcase verify
one_line: Hand an auditor one file that proves which decisions were recorded, unaltered.
verified_against: End to end in a temp HOME: keygen, capture via briefcase.observe('chain:...'), verify, bundle create/verify/inspect, tampering, and a released-format examiner bundle checked and re-packaged (output in docs/features/audit-bundle.md); CLI run through each module's register(). Format-1 compatibility: fixtures written by the released ExaminerBundle/SignedExaminerBundle code still verify. AWS KMS exercised only with an offline fake KMS client and with the existing moto tests (moto 5, run once in a scratch install); no real AWS call was made. TypeScript verifier tested on bundles written by the Python SDK. Ed25519 also tested with neither PyNaCl nor the compiled core.
